Heater replacement reference display

Existing heater, block, nozzle and thermistor geometry: the retained community hotend model by Julian0815, Open Community License v1.
https://www.printables.com/model/1533491-prusa-core-one-full-cad-with-nextruder-hotend
Full terms: ../../licenses/OCL-1.0.txt

Two M3x4bT retaining-screw illustrations: independently authored procedural geometry by CORE One Community Guide contributors. Nominal screw designation and T6 tool come from Prusa guide 944862; placement follows the existing reference block bores. Thread, recess and finish are display references, not manufacturing specifications. No supplier screw surfaces or mesh payloads are copied. Geometry: CC BY-SA 4.0; full terms at ../../licenses/CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt. Preferred editable source: ../../heater-service-geometry.js.

Procedural screw/resource source code (heater-service-geometry.js):
